text: Si on sirkooɓe ɓen on ɗaɓɓii uddital nde Alla liɓata lepte Makko ɗen e tooñooɓe jaggita ɓen, gomɗii haray nden ɗaɓɓannde mon heɓii on, O Jippini e mon lepte mon e tasakuyee gomɗuɓe ɓen. Si on haɗitike on e ɗaɓɓugol ɗum, haray ko ɗum ɓuri moƴƴannde on, tawde haawnaaki ka O nennanta on. Si on fillitike ɗaɓɓugol ɗum e haɓidugol e gomɗimɓe ɓen, Men fillitoto leptugol on, e hoore non fedde mon nden duncantaa on hay e huunde, hay si nde ɗuuɗii yeeso gomɗimɓe ɓen.Tawde pellet, Alla no wonndi e gomɗimɓe ɓen, mo Alla walli fooletaake.
